name: CoqEAL
note: Only the five CoqEAL modules that prosa implementation/refinements imports (directly or through each other) are used. They are compiled unchanged, in this order, under the pinned toolchain into the run directory; nothing is installed into an opam switch. The same five files, also unchanged, were compiled against the official prosa-0.6 switch (Rocq 9.0.1, MathComp 2.4.0) to produce planning/v06_dependency/coqeal_declaration_type_evidence.json.
